digest.component_or_area: src/rebar/llm — core LLM module comment triage and technical debt
propositions: The extra_tools field in runner.py is load-bearing (wired via completion_recovery.py and runs.py for story 2948) despite a stale comment claiming it is always None; the comment must be corrected to reflect current runtime state, not deleted.

Three sites in runner.py assert Anthropic 400 errors on extended thinking with native output constraints, contradicting structured.py:228-238 which labels this rationale as stale; the gate must be reconciled to match current behavior (native_structured_output and (not thinking or native_output_with_thinking)) and corrected conservatively.

capabilities.py:166-198 contains a structurally complete ADR covering web-search capability security posture (BLOCKING gate, three numbered bounds, accepted limitation) that belongs in a new ADR-0063 with a one-line citation left in place.
providers.py:3-16 duplicates ADR-0059 §1 verbatim including file:line citations and must be collapsed to a one-line reference.
The AWS-cost capability matrix (capabilities.py:295-316) and rejected-alternative warning (capabilities.py:269-281) are measured facts and must remain verbatim as DO_NOT_MOVE.
runner.py at 800 lines with a 371-line method at C901 ceiling can recover ~46 comment lines via consolidation and citation without exceeding the capacity cap.
